title: Song - O God, Our Help in Ages Past (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: O God, Our Help in Ages Past in C major, with a one-beat pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (C, G, F).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1290-st-anne: St. Anne (hymntune, W. Croft: O God, Our Help in Ages Past), SATB; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1290)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1290), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (C, G, F), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 72 instead of 88 quarter notes a minute.
Barred with a one-beat pickup, as hymnals print the tune (the source starts it on the first beat of a bar): every note keeps its place in time, only the bar lines move.
